Services.title: Seven services. One team accountable for results.
Services.subtitle: Pick a single service or combine them into a full growth engine. Either way, you get senior people, clear timelines and honest reporting.

media-buying.title: Media Buying
media-buying.value: Every pound of ad spend, accountable.
media-buying.description: Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat campaigns built around your margins, not vanity metrics. We test fast, cut waste and scale what sells.
media-buying.intro: We plan, launch and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google, TikTok and Snapchat with one goal: profitable growth. Every campaign starts from your unit economics, so we know what a customer is worth before we spend a pound to acquire one. From there we test creatives and audiences quickly, shift budget toward what converts and report results in plain language.
media-buying.d4: Pixel, conversion API and tracking setup

s1.title: Audit
s1.body: We review your accounts, tracking and past results to find wasted spend and quick wins.

s2.title: Plan
s2.body: We set targets from your margins and map campaigns to each stage of the funnel.

s3.title: Launch & test
s3.body: Campaigns go live with multiple creatives and audiences to learn fast.

s4.title: Optimise & scale
s4.body: Weekly tuning cuts what doesn't work and scales what sells.

q1.q: Is there a minimum ad budget?
q1.a: We recommend a monthly ad budget that gives each campaign enough data to learn. We'll suggest a realistic figure after the audit.

q2.a: You do. We work inside your business accounts, so all data and history stay with you.

designs.title: Designs
designs.description: Social creatives, ad sets, packaging and print designed to one consistent system, so every touchpoint feels unmistakably you.
designs.intro: Good design makes people stop, understand and act. We create social posts, ad creatives, packaging and print built on one visual system, so every piece looks like it belongs to your brand. Each design is made for its channel and its goal, whether that's a click, a sale or simply being remembered.

s1.title: Brief
s1.body: We learn your goals, audience and the channels the designs will live on.

s2.title: Concept
s2.body: We present creative directions so you can pick the one that fits.

s3.title: Design
s3.body: The chosen direction is developed into a complete set of assets.

s4.title: Deliver
s4.body: You receive final files in every size and format you need, plus editable sources.

q1.a: Each project includes two rounds of revisions, which is usually enough to get every detail right.

q2.q: Do I get the source files?
q2.a: Yes. You receive editable source files along with the final exports.

logos.title: Logos & Identity
logos.value: A mark that signals trust on day one.
logos.description: Strategic logo and identity design in Arabic and English, with the guidelines your team needs to apply it correctly everywhere.
logos.intro: Your logo is often the first thing people see. We design marks that are simple, memorable and work equally well in Arabic and English, on a business card or a billboard. Beyond the logo, we build a complete identity system with colours, typography and clear rules, so your brand stays consistent as it grows.

s1.title: Discover
s1.body: A workshop to define your values, audience and how you want to be seen.

s2.title: Explore
s2.body: We sketch and refine several logo concepts based on the strategy.

s3.title: Refine
s3.body: The selected concept is perfected in both languages and every size.

s4.title: Systemise
s4.body: We build the colours, type and guidelines that bring the identity together.

q1.q: How long does an identity project take?
q1.a: Most identity projects take three to five weeks, depending on scope and feedback time.

q2.q: Can you refresh my existing logo?
q2.a: Yes. We can modernise your current mark while keeping the recognition you've already built.

websites.title: Websites
websites.value: Fast sites that turn visitors into leads.
websites.description: Conversion-focused websites and online stores, bilingual and RTL-ready, built to load fast, rank well and be easy for you to update.
websites.intro: Your website should work as hard as your best salesperson. We design and build fast, bilingual websites and online stores that explain what you do clearly and guide visitors to take action. Everything is built with speed, search visibility and easy updates in mind, so your site keeps performing long after launch.

s1.title: Discover
s1.body: We define goals, audiences and the pages your site needs to convert.

s2.title: Design
s2.body: Wireframes and visual designs are reviewed with you before any code is written.

s3.title: Build
s3.body: We develop, test across devices and connect analytics and forms.

s4.title: Launch
s4.body: We handle hosting, SEO basics and go-live, then train your team.

q1.q: Will I be able to edit the site myself?
q1.a: Yes. We set up an easy content management system and show your team how to use it.

q2.a: Yes. We build stores on Shopify or custom Next.js, with payments and shipping configured.

mobile-apps.title: Mobile Apps
mobile-apps.description: iOS and Android apps designed around real user journeys, from MVP to launch, with the analytics to keep improving after release.
mobile-apps.intro: We turn ideas into apps people use every day. Starting with your users' real needs, we design clear journeys and build reliable iOS and Android apps from a single codebase. We help you launch a focused first version, measure how people use it and improve it based on real data.

s1.title: Discover
s1.body: We define the problem, the users and the smallest version worth launching.

s2.title: Design
s2.body: Flows and interactive prototypes are tested before development starts.

s3.title: Develop
s3.body: We build in short sprints and share working builds as we go.

s4.title: Launch & grow
s4.body: We publish to the stores and keep improving based on usage data.

q1.q: Do you build for both iOS and Android?
q1.a: Yes. We use cross-platform technology, so one codebase serves both platforms.

q2.a: We offer maintenance and growth plans to fix issues, ship updates and add features.

photography.title: Photography
photography.value: Imagery that makes your product the hero.
photography.description: Product, food, fashion and corporate shoots in the studio or on location, art-directed to match your brand.
photography.intro: Great photos sell. We plan and shoot product, food, fashion and corporate imagery that shows your offer at its best. Every shoot is art-directed to fit your brand and the places the images will be used, from your website and ads to menus and social media.
photography.d6: Images sized for web, social and print

s1.title: Plan
s1.body: We agree on the goal, mood and a detailed shot list.

s2.title: Prepare
s2.body: We arrange styling, props, models and location if needed.

s3.title: Shoot
s3.body: Our team shoots in the studio or on location, with you involved as much as you like.

s4.title: Edit
s4.body: We select, retouch and deliver the final images ready to use.

q1.q: Can you shoot at our location?
q1.a: Yes. We bring lighting and equipment to your store, restaurant or office.

q2.q: How soon will we receive the photos?
q2.a: Final retouched images are usually delivered within five to seven working days.

social-media.title: Social Media Management
social-media.value: A feed that builds a community, not just followers.
social-media.description: Monthly content calendars, publishing, community management and reporting, so your brand shows up consistently without draining your time.
social-media.intro: Showing up consistently on social media takes time most businesses don't have. We take care of it end to end: planning content around your goals, producing posts and reels, publishing on schedule and replying to your audience. Every month you get a clear report on what worked and what we'll do next.

s1.title: Audit
s1.body: We review your accounts, audience and competitors to find opportunities.

s2.title: Plan
s2.body: We build a monthly content calendar for your approval.

s3.title: Create & publish
s3.body: Posts and reels are produced and published on schedule.

s4.title: Engage & report
s4.body: We reply to your community and report results every month.

q1.a: Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, LinkedIn and X, depending on where your audience is.

q2.q: Do I approve content before it's posted?
q2.a: Yes. You approve the monthly calendar before anything goes live.

study.summary: One QR code that opens a branded page for each business, with its menu, branches, social links and a one-tap "save contact", plus a dashboard to manage it all.
study.challenge: Local businesses print QR codes on tables, cards and shop windows, but most lead to a plain PDF or a single Instagram link. Customers leave quickly, and the owner can't tell whether anyone scanned at all.
study.solution: We built one platform that serves every client. Each business gets its own branded page and QR code, edits its content from a simple dashboard, and sees exactly how many people visited.
study.phonesCaption: Real client pages, exactly as customers see them after scanning.
study.dashboardCaption: The customers page: every client and how many people it reached.

About.title: A studio built for brands that want to lead, wherever they are.
About.intro: Mountain is a digital marketing agency working with clients worldwide. We bring strategy, design, development and paid media together in one small senior team, so ideas move from concept to campaign without getting lost in hand-offs.
About.mission: To give ambitious businesses everywhere the kind of brand and marketing usually reserved for global names, with the speed, honesty and attention of a partner who feels close by.

v1.title: Results over noise
v1.body: We measure success in leads and sales, not likes.

v2.title: Craft in every detail
v2.body: Premium is a hundred small decisions made well.

v3.title: Radical clarity
v3.body: Clear scopes, clear timelines, clear reports. No surprises.

s1.title: Discover

s2.title: Strategise

s3.title: Create

s4.title: Grow
s4.body: Launch, measure and optimise every month, doubling down on what works.
